Wall Collapse in Jaipur Kills Three, Traps Others

A wall at an under-construction site in Jaipur collapsed, resulting in the deaths of at least three labourers and injuries to several others. Rescue operations are underway for those feared trapped. Reports suggest potential engineering flaws and unusual construction methods at the site.
